text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm all finished with my 
"warm-up"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally fired up today! It's all 
thanks to getting such a good rest~♪"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I got plenty of sleep, did some knitting, 
and worked on my self-improvement...! Oh, 
and I called home, which really gave me a 
boost of energy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then! What should we start with? 
Hit me with whatever you've got! *huff* 
*puff*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seemed well-rested, and was 
bursting with motivation!
